title: Hardware-aware local AI model research, choice and optional acquisition policy
goal: Make task-specific local-model research and hardware-aware selection mandatory for every relevant FA3 application while showing other suitable candidates in-app and allowing governed optional download/install.
requirements: Research current suitable local models for every local-AI application/module/feature.
Select and recommend models using the hardware on which the application is currently running.
Show all admitted compatible alternative candidates in the consuming application.
Make eligible non-installed candidates optionally downloadable by explicit user action.
Preserve Model Router, Model Manager, HRB, Hardware Safety, Software Coexistence, License & Rights and model artifact security boundaries.
Preserve CPU-only operation and the existing display-GPU AI policy.
Apply the rule retroactively and prospectively without changing the 175 capability baseline.
